# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams/{team}

Add a team to a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-331`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| team | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — team not found
- **405** — repo is not owned by an organization
- **403** — user is not repo admin nor owner
- **422** — team already added to repo

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.AddTeam | controller | delegate to changeRepoTeam(ctx, true) |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.changeRepoTeam | controller | check org ownership; check admin/owner permission; get team; check if already has repo; call TeamAddRepository |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.TeamAddRepository | service | validate repo belongs to org; check if already has team; within transaction: insert team_repo, increment num_repos, recalculate access, auto-watch |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Repository must be owned by an organization for team operations | validation | !ctx.Repo.Owner.IsOrganization() |
| Only repo admin or org owner can add/remove teams | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Owner.RepoAdminChangeTeamAccess && !ctx.Repo.Permission.IsOwner() |
| Cannot add a team that is already assigned to the repository | validation | add && repoHasTeam |
| Auto-watch repo for team members when team is added (if setting enabled) | business_logic | setting.Service.AutoWatchNewRepos |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| repo owner is not organization | 405 | error | False |
| user not admin/owner | 403 | forbidden | False |
| team already assigned | 422 | validationError | False |

### Error Paths

- **repo not owned by org** → changeRepoTeam → 405
- **user not admin/owner** → changeRepoTeam → 403
- **team not found** → getTeamByParam → 404
- **team already added** → changeRepoTeam → 422
